records.name: Vue UButton
records.purpose: Native action button with loading, icon, badge, polymorphic root and tooltip; retains pilot vue.button identity.
records.surface: label/icon/iconPos(left default)/iconClass, badge/badgeClass/badgeSeverity(secondary), loading(false)/loadingIcon, as(BUTTON)/asChild(false), link/severity/raised/rounded/text/outlined/size/variant/plain/fluid(null), ariaLabel, tooltip/tooltipOptions are declared props. pcFluid injection supplies fluid when null. Loading uses SpinnerIcon and disables only the native button root. rootAttrs explicitly merges attrs then overrides aria-label, disabled and type; default type is button. asChild renders the default slot with class only, not a cloned child. Default slot follows label; badge is a span, not UBadge; badgeSeverity is declared but unused in rendering. Ripple and tooltip directives attach only on the normal root. styleParams, tag, hasIcon, resolvedAriaLabel, rootAttrs and tooltipBinding are owned computed helpers. ButtonClassesParams is a source-only style contract, not a public barrel type. UButton and createBaseButton are named exports from both @ultimate/vue and @ultimate/vue/button. createBaseButton is a public zero-argument Options-API base factory, extending createBaseComponent({componentName,styleModule}), not a Composition API hook. cx class resolution and mounted registerComponentStyle belong to vue-core, not this record. ButtonClassesParams, buttonStyleModule and local css/classes resolvers are owned source-only style/helper/type declarations; no style subpath is advertised. CSS imports the shared token-bearing style string from @ultimate/uix-styles/button. Aura registry has the button token namespace. BUTTON_METADATA points to base-button.ts. Declared manifest dist entry/type paths establish intended consumer availability, not built artifacts or publication. No standalone scoped composable or directive implementation is exported.
